name: The Sleepless Sentinels
title: The Sleepless Sentinels
summary: 'A long row of Empyrean Statues ... Why would the Empyrean line up all these statues in the middle of nowhere?' (Quick Reference Card). In the kit: 55 Empyrean statues (0x02000397, 2.8 m) in one 187 m file running almost due north-south over a sand dune, from z 10 at the north end over the crest (z 25, y 19440-19465) to z 21 in the south, 3.5 m apart, in empty yellow desert. Landblocks 0x9264-0x9266 (200 m east) are missing, so all cameras stay west of x 27830.

site.name: The Sleepless Sentinels
site.notes: Derived @teleloc 17 m west of the statue line at the dune crest (open sand, nothing within 15 m). The gazetteer name match (@tele 33.50S 13.10E) is the Hamud Cottages route start, not the statues.

shots.standingOrder: Hang 45 m straight above the dune crest with the line of statues and their long evening shadows crossing the frame, turning 35 degrees; nothing above the sand within 40 m.
shots.notes: God's-eye view of the dune crest: the file of statues crosses the frame as a graphic line with long shadows from the low sun, the frame turning 35 degrees. shots.standingOrder: Skim north 3 m over the sand 8 m west of the line of Empyrean statues, over the dune crest and down its far side with the statues streaming past on the right; keep 6 m from every statue, rats may be faded.
shots.notes: Speed shot along the Sleepless Sentinels: 55 Empyrean statues in a single 187 m north-south file over a dune in the empty desert. The skim runs 3 m over the sand 8 m west of the file, crests the dune at about t 4 and drops down the far side, the statues streaming past on the right, lit by the low golden sun from the left. No subject (path move). shots.standingOrder: Dolly in low from 24 m north-north-west onto the last statue of the row as the long file of sentinels climbs the dune behind it; stop 3.5 m short of it and keep 6 m from its neighbour, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Dolly-in at the north end of the file: the last statue grows from extreme wide to full shot while the long line of sentinels climbs the dune behind it; golden sun from the west side-lights the row and stretches its shadows east.
